pending_commit.commit_message: arc: networkd: Scope devices by guest. This patch scopes device discovery and related activities by guest lifetime events. Specifically, when ARC++/VM starts or stops. This is necessary in order to ensure the correct type of device is built (corresponding to the ARC guest). This is suitable to support ARCVM networking in the near term but will need to be revisited when additional guest(s) are added. This patch sets the stage for introducing ARCVM specific helper and configuration code. BUG=b:133193765 TEST=manual validation on nocturne (arc++) and atlas (arcvm) Cq-Depend: chromium:1648551 Change-Id: Iaefc98461da425df969d59860f468718bcbb4b89 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1663632 Tested-by: Garrick Evans <garrick@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Garrick Evans <garrick@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Hugo Benichi <hugobenichi@google.com>

arc: vm_tools: Concierge notifies arc-networkd on ARCVM start/stop. This patch moves the guest start/stop notifications from upstart to Concierge. In so doing, the message format is also updated (though this is temporary as it will ultimately become a proto) and carries the ARCVM vsock cid along so the adb-proxy can connect as expected. linux-headers: add nl80211_sta_info enums Kernel support for following nl80211_sta_info enums is necessary for user-space to populate their respective entries 1. NL80211_STA_INFO_ACK_SIGNAL - support to get ack signal in probe client response and in station info from user 2. NL80211_STA_INFO_ACK_SIGNAL_AVG - avg signal strength of ACK frames 3. NL80211_STA_INFO_RX_MPDUS - total number of received packets 4. NL80211_STA_INFO_FCS_ERROR_COUNT - total number of packets (MPDUs) received with an FCS error 5. NL80211_STA_INFO_CONNECTED_TO_GATE - gate connectivity in station info 6. NL80211_STA_INFO_TX_DURATION - aggregate PPDU duration for all frames sent to the station 7. NL80211_STA_INFO_AIRTIME_WEIGHT - current airtime weight for station 8. NL80211_STA_INFO_AIRTIME_LINK_METRIC - airtime link metric for mesh station BUG=b:122467941 TEST=Build for Jetstream products Change-Id: Ifcea902d8358585d966095f07526a6f8b6b816d8 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1544980 Tested-by: NARAYANRADDI MASTI <nmasti@google.com> Tested-by: Omkar Bahirat <omkarvijay@google.com> Commit-Ready: NARAYANRADDI MASTI <nmasti@google.com> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Brian Norris <briannorris@chromium.org>
